browser_tab.name: 01. GOOGLE GEMINI TAB / HEADER
browser_tab.description:
Hover over your Gemini browser tab or taskbar icon.
Antigravity clicks here to bring Gemini to the foreground.

prompt_box.name: 02. GOOGLE GEMINI CHAT INPUT
prompt_box.description:
Hover inside Gemini prompt input composer box.
Antigravity clicks here to paste images and CAD prompts.

send_button.name: 03. GOOGLE GEMINI SEND BUTTON
send_button.description:
Hover over Gemini send button arrow.
Antigravity clicks here to submit prompts.

copy_button.name: 04. GOOGLE GEMINI COPY BUTTON
copy_button.description:
Hover over Gemini Copy response button icon at bottom of message.
Antigravity clicks here to extract CAD data.

antigravity_header.name: 05. ANTIGRAVITY WINDOW / TOP HEADER
antigravity_header.description:
Hover over the top title bar or tab header of this Antigravity IDE window.
Antigravity clicks here to bring the IDE window to the top/foreground.

ide_chat_box.name: 06. ANTIGRAVITY IDE CHAT INPUT
ide_chat_box.description:
Hover inside the chat input box at the bottom of this Antigravity IDE window.
Antigravity clicks here to paste the browser's LLM response directly into this chat.
